faqs.a: It overlays your signature as an image on the page you choose. That is a visible self-signature — convenient and widely accepted for everyday documents, but it is not a cryptographic digital signature.
faqs.q: Is this a legally binding digital signature?

faqs.a: No. The tool draws a visible signature image. Certified digital signatures with identity verification are a different technology and are not included.
faqs.q: Does it add a certified digital signature?

faqs.q: Can I choose where the signature goes?

faqs.a: The signature is embedded at the size you set. On a typical A4 page at 30% width it prints clearly; very small sizes may look soft when printed large.

sign-pdf.formula:
sigW = (wPct / 100) × pageW
sigH = sigW × (imgH / imgW)
x = clamp(cx − sigW/2, 0, pageW − sigW)
y = clamp(pageH − cyTop − sigH/2, 0, pageH − sigH)

PDF coordinates start at the bottom-left, so Y is measured from the top and converted. The signature keeps its drawn aspect ratio.
howTo: Upload the PDF you want to sign (up to 50 MB).
Draw your signature on the pad, or switch to type mode and enter your name.
Clear and retry until it looks right — the preview updates live.
Pick the page number and position the signature with the X, Y and width sliders.
Click to place the signature and download your signed PDF.
keyFacts: Two signature styles: freehand drawing on a signature pad, or a typed name rendered in script lettering.
The signature is embedded as a transparent PNG, so it overlays cleanly without a white box.
Placement is fully controllable: page number, horizontal and vertical position, and width as a percentage of the page.
Aspect ratio is preserved automatically — resizing never stretches the signature.
Everything runs locally; the signature artwork never leaves your browser.

sign-pdf.workedExample:
An A4 page is 595.28 pt wide and 841.89 pt tall. Your drawing pad is 600 × 220 px.
Width 30% → sigW = 0.30 × 595.28 = 178.58 pt.
Height keeps aspect: sigH = 178.58 × (220/600) = 65.48 pt.
X 50% → cx = 297.64 → x = 297.64 − 89.29 = 208.35 pt.
Y 80% from top → cyTop = 673.51 → y = 841.89 − 673.51 − 32.74 = 135.64 pt.
The signature lands centered horizontally, near the bottom of the page.
